aggregate_authoritative_with_flags.json.reason: an aggregate over environmentally unsuitable samples is not authoritative

aggregate_fit_without_fit_metadata.json.reason: a fitted per-step metric must record the step counts and fit method used

aggregate_sample_count_mismatch.json.reason: sample_count must match the number of contributing run_ids

aggregate_without_run_ids.json.reason: an aggregate must name the raw samples it was computed from

completed_gpu_record_without_device_meta.reason: a GPU run that executed must identify its driver stack

completed_run_without_timing.json.reason: a completed run must carry a measured process wall time

cpu_record_with_gpu_identity.json.reason: a CPU run must not carry GPU identity

dirty_tree_without_flag.json.reason: a dirty source tree must raise the dirty_tree quality flag

environment_valid_with_quality_flag.json.reason: a raised quality flag clears environment validity even when the run is numerically valid

failed_run_claimed_valid.json.reason: a run that did not complete cannot be numerically or environmentally valid

fft_grid_points_inconsistent.json.reason: fft_grid_points must be the point count of the grid actually transformed

fft_workload_without_grid.json.reason: an FFT/dipole workload must record its grid explicitly

gpu_record_without_effective_gpu_precisi.reason: effective GPU precision must be stated for a GPU run and is not inferred from CMake option names

gpu_record_without_gpu_backend.json.reason: a GPU run must name its programming model

mean_exceeds_max_neighbors.json.reason: mean neighbour count cannot exceed the maximum neighbour count

missing_required_natom.json.reason: a required identity/workload field is absent

mixed_precision_marked_supported.json.reason: MIXED is not a supported production mode and must be recorded as unsupported

mpi_ranks_field_present.json.reason: MPI is explicitly out of scope: mpi_ranks is not part of the contract and unknown fields are rejected

neighbour_workload_with_fft_grid.json.reason: a pure neighbour-list workload must not claim an FFT grid

neighbour_workload_without_neighbour_met.reason: neighbour-list workloads must carry neighbour-workload metadata; atom count alone is not enough

raw_record_with_derived_timing.json.reason: derived/fitted timing fields stay empty in raw sample records

raw_record_with_statistics.json.reason: raw sample records remain individual; statistics belong in aggregate records

short_git_commit.json.reason: provenance requires the full commit hash

unknown_measurement_profile.json.reason: measurement profiles are a closed set: DYNAMICS_ONLY or PRODUCTION_LIGHT

unknown_record_kind.json.reason: the record kind discriminator selects the schema and must be known

unmatched_precision_claimed_matched.json.reason: CPU double against GPU single is a production-configuration comparison, not a precision-matched one

wrong_major_schema_version.json.reason: a v2 record is not validated by the v1 contract

zero_natom.json.reason: a benchmark run simulates at least one atom

zero_omp_threads.json.reason: the OpenMP thread count in force is at least one
